brand.name: Papudo en tu mano
brand.tagline: Papudo's beaches, countryside and heritage, in your pocket.

home.title: Salt, sun and countryside: let's go to Papudo!
home.subtitle: Beaches for a dip, dunes to get lost in and corners with small-town flavour. Your pocket guide to enjoying it as a family, no account needed.
home.search: What are you craving? Beach, ice cream, a stroll…
home.whatToDo: What do you want to do?
home.demoNotice: Test version: places list their source but are still pending on-site verification. Lodging and food are being added with the Municipality and the Chamber of Commerce.
home.mapSubtitle: Sea, dunes and hills of Papudo, Pullally and Las Salinas. Tap a point to see its page.
home.whatToDoHint: Pick a plan and swipe for more

map.unavailable: The map is unavailable right now. You can keep using the list.

info.title: Info
info.subtitle: About Papudo and this data.
info.authorBody: This guide is built by Cristóbal Roco, a specialist in development and artificial-intelligence solutions for businesses.
info.authorNote: Illustrations are made with AI and shown with their label. Data is always checked against sources and the community.
info.dataBody: Every place shows its source and verification status. Nothing is treated as confirmed until a person reviews it: opening hours, prices and access may change.
info.emergencyNote: Chile's national numbers, free from any phone.
info.kioskBody: A screen designed for tablets at the information offices: big buttons, a QR to continue on your phone, and it returns to the start by itself.

village.noPlaces: There are no published places in this village yet.

errors.notFoundBody: The link may be mistyped or the place is no longer published.
errors.errorBody: We had a problem showing this page. Please try again.

business.title: For business
business.subtitle: Add your lodging, restaurant or activity to Papudo's travel guide.
business.pitchTitle: Visitors are already looking for where to stay, eat and what to do
business.pitchBody: Papudo en tu mano brings together the commune's beaches, routes and trips. Your business can show up right when someone plans their day.

free.title: Free listing
free.body: Your business name, description, opening hours and contact in the guide.

verified.title: Verified information
verified.body: We check your details with you, so visitors trust what they see.

routes.title: In routes and trips
routes.body: Your business can be added to "My trip" with one tap.

directions.title: Get directions
directions.body: A direct button to phone navigation.

qr.title: Your QR for the shop
qr.body: A printable poster so your customers discover Papudo.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.body: How many people viewed your listing and asked for directions (coming soon).

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.body: Tell us what you offer and where you are.

verify.title: We verify
verify.body: We confirm location, hours and contact with you.

publish.title: We publish
publish.body: Your listing appears in the guide, in Spanish and English.

business.muniTitle: For the Municipality and the Chamber of Commerce
business.muniBody: An up-to-date tourism inventory, sourced and verified information, and usage metrics to measure each season's impact.
business.notOpen: This is a test version: business sign-ups are not open yet. The places you see in the guide are samples, built from public data with their sources.

qr.help: The QR opens the guide and tells us which shop the visit came from, with no personal data.
qr.headline: Discover Papudo from your phone
qr.qrAlt: QR code to the Papudo en tu mano guide
qr.scan: Scan with your camera: beaches, routes and trips, no download needed.
qr.placeNone: No place: goes to the home page

live.title: Live trip
live.gpsDenied: We don't have permission to use your location. Enable it in your browser settings to follow the live trip.
live.gpsUnavailable: We couldn't get your location. Check that GPS is on.
live.mapUnavailable: The map isn't available, but the guide below still works.
live.straightLineNote: Straight-line distance: the real path may be longer. To follow streets, open Google Maps.
live.noCompass: No compass: your destination is to the {direction}. Walk a few steps and the arrow will follow your movement.
live.cameraOff: No camera access: the guide still works.
live.cameraSafety: Watch the path and take care when crossing. The arrow is approximate (GPS ± 5–15 m).
live.demoBanner: Demo mode: your location is simulated and moves on its own towards the next stop. Turn your phone to try the camera arrow.
live.cameraFar: See the direction with the camera
live.nearestHint: You're closer to {name} ({distance}). Want to start there?
live.cameraOffHint: If you opened the link from WhatsApp or Instagram, open it in Chrome or Safari and allow camera access.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.count: {count, plural, =0 {No reviews yet} one {# review} other {# reviews}}
reviews.comingSoon: Soon you'll be able to rate with stars and leave a review by signing in with Google. Reviews are moderated before they're published.
reviews.ownerReply: The business will be able to reply to reviews from its dashboard.
reviews.demoNote: Demo: the example reviews are fictional. Yours is saved only on this device; the real version will have accounts and moderation before publishing.
reviews.outOf5: out of 5 · {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}}

reviews.textPlaceholder: What did you like? What would you improve?
reviews.errorText: Write at least a few words about your experience.
reviews.thanks: Thank you! Your review now appears below. In the real version it will be moderated before it is published.
reviews.realNote: Reviews are published when sent. Offensive or off-topic ones are removed.
reviews.published: Thank you! Your review is now published.
reviews.errorProfanity: Your review contains offensive words. Please rewrite it.
reviews.errorRate: You sent several reviews in a row. Please try again later.
reviews.errorGeneric: Your review could not be published. Please try again in a moment.
reviews.mediaHelp: Up to 4 files (one video, max. 1 minute), 25 MB each. They are reviewed before being shown.
reviews.blocked: “{name}” can’t be published: it seems to contain inappropriate content.
reviews.unreadable: We couldn’t check “{name}”. Try a JPG, PNG or MP4 video.
reviews.tooMany: You can upload up to 4 files and only one video.
reviews.badType: “{name}” is not a JPG, PNG or WebP photo or an MP4, WebM or MOV video.
reviews.mediaPending: Your photos and videos will be shown once the team reviews them.

reviews.errorMedia: One of the files can’t be published.

events.title: Events calendar
events.subtitle: Festivals and celebrations that repeat every year in Papudo, Pullally and Las Salinas.
events.confirmNote: These are festivals that repeat every year, with no date for a specific edition. Check the day and programme with the Municipality before you go. The calendar is reviewed every quarter.
events.empty: There are no events with a source for this product yet.
events.homeSubtitle: What repeats every year in the commune.
events.demoBanner: Example event: it is fictional and was created to show how it would look in the calendar.

share.expiredBody: The Papudo en tu mano preview was shared for a limited time. Ask the person who sent it for a new link.
share.linkBody: Anyone who opens it can see the preview until {expires} (Chile time). After that, the link stops working.
share.askPassword: Enter the key to create links
share.teamLinkBody: Permanent team link: it does not expire. Share it only with the team; if it leaks, change the key and create a new one (that also cuts the timed links).

signIn.title: Sign in to the panel
signIn.error: Wrong email or password, or your account has no access to the panel.
signIn.notConfigured: The panel needs the database to be configured.

form.title: Change verification status
form.saved: Saved. The public site updates in a few minutes.
form.error: Could not save. Check your role or try again.
form.readOnly: Your role can view but not verify.

reviews.title: Visitor reviews
reviews.intro: They are published when sent. Hide inappropriate ones; deleting is permanent (administration only).
reviews.saved: Done. The change is already visible on the public site.
reviews.error: Could not apply. Check your role or try again.

business.title: Businesses
business.intro: Action button for each business, featured notices with an end date and the invitation to join the guide.
business.saved: Saved. The public site already shows the change.
business.error: Could not save. Check the data (links with https://, number with country code) or your role.

cta.title: Action button on the listing
cta.help: A prominent button on the business listing. WhatsApp and phone: the number with country code (+56 9 …). Website, menu, booking and Instagram: the full link.
cta.none: There are no businesses in the guide yet.

notices.title: Featured notices
notices.help: Promotions or announcements with an end date. A business's notices appear on its listing; general ones, on the home page. They expire automatically.

invite.title: Invitation to businesses
invite.help: “Do you run a business in Papudo?” box on the explorer and business listings. With the form link, the button goes straight to it; without it, to the For businesses page.
invite.adminOnly: Only administration can change this setting.

updates.title: Information updates (every 6 months)
updates.help: Each business must confirm or update its details at least every 6 months. When it does, mark it here: the public page shows the date and warns visitors if it is old.
updates.copyHint: Copy the message and send it through the channel you use with the business.
updates.template: Hi, this is the «Papudo en tu mano» guide team. So visitors find accurate information about {name}, could you confirm or update your hours, contact details, prices and services? This is how your page looks today: {url} Thank you!
updates.pendingCount: {count, plural, one {# business needs} other {# businesses need}} to confirm their details (every 6 months).

admin.localitiesHelp: Towns and areas of the commune. Shown on the site with their places.

preview.title: Preview on the site
preview.help: This is how visitors see it (phone version). Changes may take a few minutes to appear.
preview.notPublished: Not published: the site does not show it yet.

places.newHelp: Create the page for a restaurant, lodging, tourism service or any business. If you don't publish it, it stays as a draft and the site doesn't show it. After creating it you upload its logo, menu and photos.
places.created: Page created. Now upload its logo, menu and photos.
places.saved: Saved. The public site updates in a few minutes.

errors.name: The name must be 3 to 80 characters long.
errors.button: The action button is not valid: WhatsApp or phone needs the number with country code; the others, a full link with https://.
errors.link: Check the links: Instagram (@user or link), website and Google Maps (with https://).
errors.sernatur: The SERNATUR registration needs its number (digits only) and the validity date.
errors.email: The contact email is not valid.
errors.save: Could not save. Check your role or try again.
errors.hours: Check the hours: each row needs a start and end month, at least one day and opening and closing times.
errors.imageText: The image text must be 3 to 300 characters long.

form.name: Business name
form.short: A phrase that makes it special
form.hoursHelp: As reported by the business. Shown with “Provided by the business”.
form.contactHelp: To ask for updates every 6 months. Only staff see it.
form.contactName: Name of who signed the business up
form.draftNote: If not published, the page stays as a draft.
form.ownerValidatedHelp: Tick this only if the owner or manager confirmed the details. The page shows it as the source.

publication.adminOnly: Only administrators can publish or unpublish.

photos.title: Logo, menu and photos
photos.help: They are resized and their hidden data (like phone location) is removed before saving. The first photo is the business cover; with no photos, the logo is used.
photos.uploaded: {count, plural, one {# file uploaded.} other {# files uploaded.}}
photos.saveFirst: Create the page first to upload images.

errors.type: “{name}”: only JPG, PNG or WebP are accepted.
errors.size: “{name}” is too large (max. 4 MB after resizing).
errors.read: “{name}” could not be read as an image.
errors.save: “{name}” could not be saved. Try again.
errors.denied: You don't have permission to upload images.
errors.videoRead: “{name}” could not be read as a video.

photos.authNote: Only upload images the business provided or authorized.
photos.alt: Alt text (for people who can't see the image)
photos.creditHelp: Applies to what you upload now.
photos.videoHelp: MP4, WebM or MOV, up to {max} MB each. They are uploaded as they are, without resizing: if it is larger, compress it first (for example, export it at medium quality from the phone).

import.title: Import businesses from a spreadsheet
import.help: Reads the “Suma tu comercio” form spreadsheet (or another with the same questions) and shows what would be created or changed before saving anything. Only what is new or changed since last time is loaded.
import.urlHelp: The spreadsheet must be shared as “anyone with the link can view”.
import.draftNote: If not published, new ones stay as drafts.

reason.noAuthorization: Did not tick the publishing authorization.

import.duplicates: Answered {count} more times: the latest answer is used.
import.summary: {count, plural, =0 {No businesses in the spreadsheet.} one {# business in the spreadsheet.} other {# businesses in the spreadsheet.}}
import.nothing: Nothing to load: everything is up to date.

result.created: {count, plural, =0 {None new} one {# new} other {# new}}

errors.badUrl: The link is not a Google Sheets link.
errors.fetch: Could not read the spreadsheet. Check it is shared with “anyone with the link” or upload the CSV file.
errors.denied: You don't have permission to import.
errors.file: The file is too large or could not be read.
errors.source: Could not read the spreadsheet again. Review it again.

import.newFiles: When you finish, open each new business to upload its logo, menu and photos.

hours.title: Seasonal hours
hours.help: One row per season, repeating every year (for example, January to February every day, and March to December weekends and public holidays only). If hours are set here, the page shows them instead of the free text in “Days and hours”. Tick “Remove” and save to delete a row.

businessInvite.title: Do you run a business in Papudo?
businessInvite.body: Add it to the guide: lodging, food, activities or local products. Free this season.
